//: Typecheck config for the conversation harness (Wave1-L3).
WHY THIS EXISTS: neither of the repo's typecheck gates covers this tool.
tsconfig.build.json includes only src/**/*.ts; the root tsconfig.json includes
src, tests, *.config.ts and sdk — tools/ appears in NEITHER. Vitest runs the
harness through esbuild, which strips types without checking them, so until
now a type error in scorer/ could not fail any gate. That is a poor property
for the code that decides whether a coach prompt ships.
Scope note: this checks the harness scorer + its self-tests. It reaches into
src/ only via the production guard imports score-run.ts and
unsupported-claim-adapter.ts deliberately make (never copies) — those are
pulled in transitively and checked against the real production types, which
is the point: if a guard's signature moves, this fails.
src/**/*.d.ts is included because the ambient module declarations src/ relies
on (e.g. cqe/compromise-numbers.d.ts) are picked up by tsconfig.build.json via
its src/**/*.ts glob. Transitively importing a src/ module without them
resurfaces settled TS7016s that are not this tool's to fix.
